_comment: DRAFT split -- freeze this before running any sweep, and never edit it afterwards. 'seen' are the categories named in the proposal (near-certainly present in asciiart.eu and in pretraining). 'held_out' are never shown as exemplars and are used to test transfer. 'exemplar_only' exist solely to fill few-shot slots, and are disjoint from held_out so a few-shot prompt can never leak its own test category.
